correctness.rationale: The squared automorphism is an admissible Schur witness with fixed constant term rho. Its coefficient formula is exact, and for 0<rho<=1/3 its sign pattern makes the closed majorant formula exact. The difference from the comparison automorphism majorant factors into a positive denominator times minus one explicit cubic. Endpoint signs and negativity of the cubic derivative on [1/3,1] establish a unique crossing, so every radius above that crossing is genuinely excluded.

value.rationale: The motivating note ends with the fixed-value radius as a concrete open problem. The finding supplies a single explicit inner family that yields a computable algebraic upper curve throughout the natural low-value regime and a concrete numerical upper bound at rho=1/3. This narrows a newly stated extremal problem in a structurally motivated way without overstating the result as a full solution.
